name: Institutional Order Flow Mastery
tagline: Learn to read volume, delta and footprint charts.
description: A PDF guide that explains how order flow data is produced and how traders read it. It covers volume profile, delta, absorption and how to journal what you observe. Educational material for self-directed traders.
features: How order flow data is produced
A journaling template for your own review

name: Technical Analysis Blueprint
tagline: A structured way to read charts and build a checklist.
description: A PDF guide to the core tools of technical analysis: trend, support and resistance, momentum and volume. It shows how to combine them into a written checklist you can test on your own charts.
features: How to review your own trades

name: Trader Psychology & Discipline
tagline: Build routines that help you follow your own plan.
description: A PDF guide on habits, routines and decision making for traders. It covers pre-market preparation, handling losing streaks, and keeping a trading journal.

name: Risk Management Playbook
tagline: Position sizing and risk rules, with a worksheet.
description: A PDF guide with an Excel worksheet. It explains position sizing, stop placement, risk per trade and drawdown limits, and lets you try the numbers with your own account size.
features: Excel worksheet for your own numbers

name: Crypto Market Structure Guide
tagline: How crypto markets are organised and traded.
description: A PDF guide to how crypto exchanges, order books and liquidity work, and how market structure differs from traditional markets.

name: Forex Fundamentals & Macro Trading
description: A PDF guide to the forex market: sessions, major pairs, interest rates and economic data releases, and how traders follow them.

name: Scalping & Day Trading Tactics
tagline: Short-term trading concepts and their risks.
description: A PDF guide to short-term trading: setups, execution, costs and the risks of trading frequently. Includes how to track your results honestly.

name: Swing Trading Masterclass
tagline: Multi-day trades: planning, entries and exits.
description: A PDF guide to swing trading over days to weeks. It covers choosing markets, planning entries and exits, and reviewing trades.
